facts.text: Deborah attended an art show with a friend on 9 April 2023, which reminded her of her mother.

evidence.quote: Checked out an art show with a friend today - really cool and inspiring stuff. Reminded me of my mom.
My mom was interested in art. She believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect us.

facts.text: Deborah believes that art can evoke strong emotions and help maintain a connection with her late mother.

evidence.quote: My mom was interested in art. She believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect us.
It's amazing how something simple like artwork can bring back powerful emotions and remind us of those we've lost.

facts.text: Deborah finds comfort in keeping her mother's memory alive through activities like visiting art shows.

evidence.quote: When I go to an art show, it's like we're still experiencing it together even though she's gone. It's hard but comforting.
Finding ways to keep her memory alive gives me peace.
